## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Application PRs target `dev`;
`main` is reserved for reviewed releases.

## Validation

List relevant tests and checks. Include sanitized screenshots for interface
changes. Describe material limitations and any migration or rollback steps.

- [ ] Relevant tests and CI checks pass.
- [ ] Repository instructions and installed framework guides were followed.
- [ ] Documentation and attribution are current.
- [ ] No credentials, private deployment details, or generated files are included.
- [ ] Substantial AI assistance is disclosed.
